subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should `PluginHookAgentContext.api.resetSession(reason?)` become the permanent after-compaction plugin contract across OpenClaw, Codex, and Copilot harnesses?
rationale: This is a new public plugin capability whose availability, model-lock behavior, lifecycle ownership, and cross-harness parity become compatibility commitments; repository behavior alone cannot establish maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve the scoped hook API
options.body: Keep the current-session, reason-only, deferred API after fixing cron ownership and proving every supported harness lifecycle.

options.title: Keep resets owner-internal
options.body: Remove the public hook API and expose a narrower plugin- or context-engine-owned recovery seam instead.

options.title: Pause the capability
options.body: Close or defer the PR until the permanent plugin lifecycle contract is designed separately.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped hook API
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session, reason-only, deferred API after fixing cron ownership and proving every supported harness lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most directly connects this person to the compaction lifecycle hook contract being extended.
